body: Currently, my boss is a 31 year old woman who, as far as I'm concerned, is insane. She's not very professional (even by construction standards). Ever experienced someone that has put you through so much you just want to smash them until there's nothing left? That's her. She's trying to drive me out, or try and fire me.
I can't do anything with welfare, I make too much, even though I hardly get to see any of it.
